name: Kṛta
field_reading: The highest throw. All endeavors succeed. The field is fully coherent. Act without hesitation.

name: Tretā
field_reading: Excellent fortune. What you seek is near. The field supports movement forward.

name: Dvāpara
field_reading: Good outcome with effort. Obstacles exist but yield. The field is active — press forward.

name: Kali
field_reading: The weakest throw of this family. Proceed with awareness. The field holds tension unresolved.

name: Vijaya
field_reading: Victory. The field aligns with your intention. An auspicious time for all undertakings.

name: Jayā
field_reading: Success follows effort. The field is supportive. Move now while the current is favorable.

name: Siddhi
field_reading: Accomplishment. What has been cultivated bears fruit. The field rewards sustained practice.

name: Ṛddhi
field_reading: Growth and increase. The field expands. Resources accumulate around clear intention.

name: Śrī
field_reading: Auspicious. Lakṣmī is present in the field. Wealth beauty and harmony are indicated.

name: Hrī
field_reading: Dignity and modesty. The field calls for reserve. Do not overreach — restraint brings more than force.

name: Dhṛti
field_reading: Steadiness. The field rewards patience. Hold your position — the right moment approaches.

name: Puṣṭi
field_reading: Nourishment. The field is fertile. What is given now returns multiplied.

name: Tuṣṭi
field_reading: Contentment. The field is at rest. Satisfaction is available now — receive it.

name: Kīrti
field_reading: Reputation. The field amplifies your name. Actions taken now have lasting consequence.

name: Smṛti
field_reading: Memory and recall. The field holds what has been. Look to the past for the answer present.

name: Medhā
field_reading: Intelligence active but scattered. The field is complex. Slow down and let clarity emerge.

name: Pratibhā
field_reading: Intuition blazing. The field speaks directly. Trust what arises without translation.

name: Prajñā
field_reading: Wisdom present. The field carries deep knowledge. What you need to know is already known.

name: Śraddhā
field_reading: Faith. The field asks for surrender. Trust the process even when the outcome is not visible.

name: Māyā
field_reading: Illusion is present. The field carries confusion. What appears is not what is — look deeper.

name: Lakṣmī
field_reading: Full auspiciousness. Lakṣmī stands in the field. Abundance flows to the open hand.

name: Sarasvatī
field_reading: The goddess of knowledge and art is present. The field is luminous. Create now.

name: Durgā
field_reading: Fierce protection. The field guards what is precious. Cross the obstacle — you will not fall.

name: Kālī
field_reading: Dissolution is at work. The field clears what has expired. Release before you can receive.

name: Gāyatrī
field_reading: The mother of mantras illuminates the field. Chant speak pray — the sound carries power now.

name: Sāvitrī
field_reading: Solar force. The field is charged with vital energy. This is a time of awakening.

name: Umā
field_reading: Gentle grace. The field holds the softness of Pārvatī. Approach with love not force.

name: Rudrā
field_reading: Transformation through disruption. The field is stormy. What breaks was ready to break.

name: Indrāṇī
field_reading: Royal favor. The field carries the energy of the sovereign. Leadership and authority are supported.

name: Varuṇānī
field_reading: Deep waters. The field holds what is hidden. What moves below the surface now surfaces.

name: Brahmāṇī
field_reading: Creative force. The field is generative. Begin — the first step is the whole journey.

name: Vaiṣṇavī
field_reading: Preservation. The field holds steady. Protect what has been built before adding more.

name: Kaumārī
field_reading: Youthful energy. The field carries the enthusiasm of the warrior. Move with courage and speed.

name: Māheśvarī
field_reading: Śiva's śakti moves in the field. What is destroyed makes way for what has never existed.

name: Cāmuṇḍā
field_reading: The fierce one. The field strips illusion. Face what you have been avoiding — it holds your power.

name: Nārasiṃhī
field_reading: Ferocious protection. The field guards the threshold. What threatens you cannot cross this line.

name: Śāntā
field_reading: Peace descends. The field is still. This is not inaction — it is the calm of deep alignment.

name: Priyā
field_reading: Beloved. The field carries the fragrance of devotion. What you love is what you become.

name: Nandā
field_reading: Joy. The field is in a moment of celebration. Receive it fully — do not qualify happiness.

name: Bhadrā
field_reading: Auspicious but complex. The field holds both blessing and challenge. Navigate carefully.

name: Jayantī
field_reading: The victorious one. The field is charged with triumph. What seemed impossible now yields.

name: Maṅgalā
field_reading: Auspiciousness on all sides. The field is fully supportive. Begin all new endeavors now.

name: Aparājitā
field_reading: The unconquered. The field is invincible. No force can stop what moves with this energy.

name: Vijayā
field_reading: Victory through beauty and grace. The field rewards elegance not force. Soften to succeed.

name: Raudrī
field_reading: Fierce energy that demands outlet. The field is combustible. Direct this force or it burns you.

name: Bhīmā
field_reading: Tremendous force. The field bears tremendous weight. Set down what does not serve — travel light.

name: Ugratārā
field_reading: The fierce star. The field carries an intensity that cuts. What is cut away was blocking the view.

name: Mahiṣāsuramardinī
field_reading: The buffalo demon is slain. The field is clear of a long obstruction. Move forward freely.

name: Śubhā
field_reading: Auspiciousness. The field is favorable. All that is undertaken with pure intention succeeds.

name: Varadā
field_reading: Boon-giving. The field is generous. Ask clearly and specifically — the answer is yes.

name: Abhayā
field_reading: Fearlessness. The field holds no threat. What you fear is already behind you — turn around.

name: Śaraṇā
field_reading: Refuge. The field offers sanctuary. Rest before the next movement — restoration is the task.

name: Tārā
field_reading: The star goddess navigates. The field is a vast ocean — you have a guide. Trust the stars.

name: Bhuvaneśvarī
field_reading: Sovereign of worlds. The field is vast and benevolent. You are held in something much larger.

name: Tripurā
field_reading: Three cities — body speech mind aligned. The field is integrated. Act from wholeness not fragment.

name: Mātaṅgī
field_reading: Outcast wisdom. The field holds what the orthodox excludes. Look where others refuse to look.

name: Bagalāmukhī
field_reading: The paralyzer. The field freezes opposition. What has been blocking you is now immobilized.

name: Dhūmāvatī
field_reading: The widow smoke goddess. The field carries loss. What has ended must be honored before moving on.

name: Chinnamastā
field_reading: Self-sacrifice for life. The field demands giving what you hold most precious. This is the gift.

name: Ṣoḍaśī
field_reading: The sixteen-year-old perfection. The field is at the peak of beauty. This is the moment — enter it fully.

name: Annapūrṇā
field_reading: Full nourishment. The field feeds all who approach. Share what you have — abundance returns.

name: Saṅkarṣaṇī
field_reading: Drawing in. The field is contracting to concentrate power. Gather — do not scatter now.

name: Vāruṇī
field_reading: The intoxicating one. The field carries altered states. Perception is shifted — use this carefully.

name: Mahāvidyā
field_reading: The great wisdom. All ten Mahāvidyās present simultaneously. The field is complete. You already have what you seek.
